project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite SPA with Firebase backend, Capacitor Android, dark-themed mobile-first social media app
build_system: Vite + npm; build output in dist/
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react, setup in src/test/setup.ts
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` to verify no TypeScript/build errors. 2. Run `npm run test` to verify all unit tests pass.
environment_constraints: Open internet - npm installs work. Firebase env vars are in .env. Supabase client exists as legacy shim but primary backend is Firebase Firestore.
contribution_requirements: Use existing patterns: Firebase Firestore for data, Cloudinary for media uploads, shadcn/ui components, Framer Motion animations, dark theme with glassmorphism/gradient accents, mobile-first 440px max-width shell.
key_patterns: Firebase Firestore: collection/query/getDocs/onSnapshot pattern. Auth: useAuth() hook from src/contexts/AuthProvider.tsx returning {user, profile}. Routing: src/routes/index.tsx with ProtectedRoute wrapper and AppShell layout. Components: lucide-react icons, tailwind classes, CSS custom properties for theming (hsl(var(--name))). Media uploads: uploadToCloudinary from src/lib/cloudinary.ts. Posts have FeedPost type in PostCard.tsx with profile nested object. Stories already have a StoryViewer component but it still uses supabase for reactions.
directory_structure: src/pages/ (page components), src/components/ (UI components organized by domain: social/, dm/, vibe/, layout/, etc.), src/hooks/ (custom hooks), src/services/ (service modules), src/contexts/ (React context providers), src/lib/ (utility modules: firebase, cloudinary, format), src/routes/ (route definitions), src/test/ (test setup)
